description: DiligenceOps: submit a pricing page (text, or a public HTTPS url). The signed report lists the tiers with their prices (amount, currency, period, seat basis and billing cycle), limits and features, plus other priced items, and flags the same tier or item priced two ways on the same basis and a limit a tier states with two different values, each quoted with its offset. POST /api/pricing-evidence-check. Reads the supplied text, or one public HTTPS page read once with GET (no redirects, public DNS only, 512 KB): no account access, no merchant contact and no money movement. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. The report matches words, figures, dates and named items between the submitted texts; it does not interpret meaning beyond that matching. Contract: /api/diligence-evidence-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/diligence-checks/.

inputSchema.description: Send exactly one of text or url.

format.description: html reduces the markup to readable text first. Defaults to html when the text starts with a tag, otherwise text.

label.description: Optional name for the page, recorded in the report.

text.description: The pricing as plain text, Markdown or HTML, up to 256 KB.

url.description: A public HTTPS pricing page, read once with GET, no redirects, up to 512 KB.

name: wever_pricing-evidence-check
title: Pricing evidence check
